$comment: Every document this product can generate, besides the Mutual NDA, which keeps its own cover page in mnda-fields.json because Common Paper publishes one. Each field here is a term the document's Standard Terms actually reference - the list is derived from the templates, so it cannot describe a document the templates do not. A generated key terms page defines these, and the Standard Terms follow verbatim: the clauses are written to read with the term rather than the value, so substituting into them would alter the legal wording.
